scope: root menus at captured synthetic Qt press only; no release/cancel or command equivalence claim
extraction: stdlib JSON read + Python AST structural inspection; no third-party import, exec, eval or package run
privacy: commands, native item IDs, scene names, window titles/positions and raw selection names omitted

state_semantics.checkbox: false is the queried checkBox value; it does not alone prove the item is non-checkable

state_semantics.options: native options preserve source order and attach to the immediately preceding same-direction body item; raw Options row stays in root_sequence
state_semantics.submenus: root subMenu flags only; no submenu contents inferred or accepted
